file.description: Repo-relative path, no a/ or b/ prefix.

line.description: Line in the new file's coordinate space. 0 for a file-level finding.

reference.description: Stable rule/advisory URL when the tool emits one.

status.description: skipped = tool legitimately absent; failed = error; ok = ran.

statusReason.description: One-line reason when status is skipped or failed.

verdict.description: NONE in local mode (pre-review produces no verdict), and in PR mode when native review did not run.

bodyText.description: Rendered body, built by review-core: in PR mode the verdict headline, finding index, body notes, Dependency Freshness table and the review marker line; in local mode the full report.

subjectType.description: Present only for file-level comments (no usable line). Absent for line-level comments.

log.description: Full unfiltered analytical payload for the durable log. Host writes it to disk when orchestration.full_log is true; absent on the bare-invocation bundle.

source.description: native, or the static domain (ruff, eslint, trivy, jbinspect, housekeeper).

verdict_relevant.description: Equals blocking: a blocking finding is what drives REQUEST_CHANGES.

posting.description: inline (a comment, or a body note when fileless), the Dependency Freshness table, or nowhere.

filtered.description: rule-source: dropped for citing a CLAUDE.md outside the repo; severity-unreachable: a static Critical not on its allow-list, posted non-blocking.

origin.description: Where a finding moved to the body pointed (file:line outside the diff).

voice.description: Wording-pass records: one per field the comment-editor changed, accepted or not. Absent when it changed nothing or did not run.

index.description: Position in the item list sent to the editor.

accepted.description: True when every guard passed and the rewrite replaced the original.

reason.description: Why a guard rejected the rewrite; null when accepted.

meta.description: Reconstruction keys for the per-cog corpus. The diff is regenerated from these, never stored.

cli_version.description: The Claude Code version whose bundled /code-review produced the native findings, or unknown.

cogs.description: Per-cog I/O records: one round1 record per static specialist and one native record. input omitted (diff reconstructed from meta).

native.description: Whether Anthropic's bundled /code-review ran and returned a valid findings array.

reason.description: Why native did not run; empty when it ran.

counts.description: Surfaced findings (inline and body notes), for the host prompt templates.

source.description: native or a static domain → count.
